kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انحسرت (form VII)
# اِنْحَسَرْتُ (inḥasartu) /in.ħa.sar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# اِنْحَسَرْتَ (inḥasarta) /in.ħa.sar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# اِنْحَسَرْتِ (inḥasarti) /in.ħa.sar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# اِنْحَسَرَتْ (inḥasarat) /in.ħa.sa.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
